adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, calendar references were refactored from a single reference (`find`) to multiple references (`filter`) and processed in a loop. However, the merge-cleanup block still uses `const oldCalendarEvent = booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"));`, meaning only one (the first) old calendar reference will be handled when `newBookingId` is present. With the new multi-destination/collective-host behavior that can create multiple `*_calendar` references, this leaves other old references untouched, plausibly resulting in stale duplicate events for other hosts.
